description: Retrofit cost reference bands by scope. These are historical benchmarks and screening ranges, NOT current-year bids: adjust for currency_year, labor market, and scope adders before quoting. lo/p50/hi are USD per unit_basis.

rows.label: Retro-commissioning / controls tuning
rows.source: LBNL 2020 existing-building commissioning meta-analysis (median $0.26/ft2, median payback 1.7 yr); rule-of-thumb range $0.05-0.50/ft2

rows.label: Minor HVAC + controls package
rows.source: LBNL/NAESCO fact sheets: minor HVAC median turnkey ~$2.3-2.4/ft2 (federal + post-secondary datasets)

rows.label: Full BAS overlay / replacement
rows.source: Vendor budgetary estimating guides ($2.50-7.50/ft2 installed BAS/BMS); sales ranges, not peer-reviewed

rows.label: Major HVAC retrofit (chillers, boilers, towers, distribution)
rows.source: LBNL ESCO database: median major-HVAC investment ~$4.6/ft2 (2009$); LBNL taxonomy uses $5/ft2 as the major/minor line

rows.label: Envelope-heavy / capital-renewal package (roof, ceiling)
rows.source: LBNL ESCO database: high-cost non-energy projects median ~$9.1/ft2 (2009$), includes roof/ceiling replacement

rows.label: Full commercial window replacement
rows.source: Commercial windows market study: ~$39.7/glazing-ft2 illustrative (50k ft2 building, 15% glazing, $298k project)

rows.label: Secondary windows (interior panel retrofit)
rows.source: Commercial windows study ~$35.0/glazing-ft2; NEEA field study average $38.57/glazing-ft2 across six sites

rows.label: Deep HVAC + envelope redesign
rows.source: RMI deep-retrofit guide ($25-150+/ft2); LBNL decarbonization comparisons ~$28 vs $57/ft2
